name: MOM
description: Compounded total return over months t-11..t-1 (skips the most recent month)
lag: returns through month t-1; needs 8 of 11 months

name: IMOM
description: Six-month compounded value-weighted return of the stock's Fama-French 48 industry (S&P 500 members, weights = previous month-end market caps), months t-5..t
lag: returns through month t; industry needs >= 3 members

name: HIGH52
description: Month-end split-adjusted price divided by its highest daily price over the trailing 12 months
lag: daily prices through month t; needs 6 months of daily data

name: STREV
description: Total return in month t (losers outperform next month)
reference: Jegadeesh (1990), Journal of Finance; Lehmann (1990), Quarterly Journal of Economics
lag: return of month t, known at its close

name: LTREV
description: Compounded total return over months t-59..t-12 (long-term losers outperform)
reference: De Bondt & Thaler (1985), Journal of Finance
lag: returns through month t-12; needs 36 of 48 months

name: BM
description: log(book equity / market equity); Fama-French book equity, market equity of all the issuer's share classes at month t (current price, as in Asness & Frazzini 2013); positive book equity only
reference: Rosenberg, Reid & Lanstein (1985), Journal of Portfolio Management; Fama & French (1992), Journal of Finance
lag: annual record usable from the end of the 6th month after fiscal year end, for up to 18 months

name: EP
description: Earnings before extraordinary items (ib) / market equity at month t
lag: annual record usable from the end of the 6th month after fiscal year end, for up to 18 months

name: CFP
description: Cash flow (ib + depreciation dp) / market equity at month t
reference: Lakonishok, Shleifer & Vishny (1994), Journal of Finance
lag: annual record usable from the end of the 6th month after fiscal year end, for up to 18 months

name: GPA
lag: annual record usable from the end of the 6th month after fiscal year end, for up to 18 months

name: ROA
description: Earnings before extraordinary items / total assets
reference: Haugen & Baker (1996), Journal of Financial Economics
lag: annual record usable from the end of the 6th month after fiscal year end, for up to 18 months

name: ACC
description: Balance-sheet operating accruals: change in non-cash current assets minus change in current liabilities excluding short-term debt, minus depreciation, over average total assets
lag: annual record usable from the end of the 6th month after fiscal year end, for up to 18 months; needs the prior year

name: AG
description: Total asset growth over the fiscal year (at / at_prev - 1)
reference: Cooper, Gulen & Schill (2008), Journal of Finance
lag: annual record usable from the end of the 6th month after fiscal year end, for up to 18 months; needs the prior year

name: NSI
description: Net share issuance: log change in split-adjusted shares outstanding (shrout x cfacshr) over the past 12 months
lag: shares outstanding at months t and t-12

name: IVOL
description: Idiosyncratic volatility: standard deviation of daily residuals from a Fama-French three-factor regression within month t
reference: Ang, Hodrick, Xing & Zhang (2006), Journal of Finance
lag: daily returns of month t; needs 15 days

name: BETA
description: Market beta from daily excess returns on the market factor over the trailing 12 months
reference: Black, Jensen & Scholes (1972); Frazzini & Pedersen (2014), Journal of Financial Economics
lag: daily returns through month t; needs 120 days

name: SEAS
description: Average return in the calendar month being predicted over the previous five years (months t-11, t-23, t-35, t-47, t-59)
reference: Heston & Sadka (2008), Journal of Financial Economics
lag: returns through month t-11; needs 3 of 5 years
